text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: New incident created: OPAL-DED-OUTAGE-2026 — Elevated 5xx rate affecting Opal Financial (dedicated pool opal-ded-3). Pager: maya (oncall). Bridge: https://redwood/bridge/OPAL-DED-4567

maya (oncall): Paged at 09:12 UTC. Seeing ~18% 503s from inference-gateway -> model-proxy for requests with long context. Initial hypothesis: KV cache thrash after a spike of long-sequence requests.

rishi (sre): Taking handoff. Joining bridge. Key signals: GPU utilization normal, but worker restarts noted in opal-ded-3 around 09:07. Possible memory leak in the runtime patch rolled yesterday.

elaine (eng): I'm on it — rolling back runtime patch r2026.14 on opal-ded-3 to r2026.12 on a single node to confirm. Will monitor if 5xx rate drops.

maya (oncall): Can we reduce routing to opal-ded-3 and fail traffic to opal-ded-1/2 temporarily? Want to avoid customer impact widening.

rishi (sre): Creating temporary routing rule: divert 60% of Opal traffic to opal-ded-1/2. Applying now.

ops-bot: executed: `infra route-set --pool opal-ded --weight opal-ded-3=40,opal-ded-1=30,opal-ded-2=30` (cmd id: 0x9b7c).

elaine (eng): Rollback complete on one node. 5xxs dropped to ~6% on that node. Keep rollback while we verify. I'm preparing a full rollback plan if needed.

lydia (cs): FYI — Opal is a tier-1 customer. Sean, do you want a quick heads-up now or wait for a status page?

sean (acct): Heads-up now please. Use the external wording: 'We are seeing degraded performance for inference requests on your dedicated pool. Our engineers have applied mitigations; we're monitoring. We will update within 30 minutes or sooner.' I'll take the call if Opal reaches out.

maya (oncall): Draft status page update (proposed):

```
Incident OPAL-DED-OUTAGE-2026 — Degraded inference service for Opal Financial
Status: Partial service degradation (investigating)
Impact: Some inference requests to Opal Financial's dedicated pool (opal-ded-3) may receive 5xx errors or increased latency. A subset of traffic has been rerouted to alternate nodes to reduce impact.
Mitigation: Engineers rolled back a recent runtime change on affected nodes and applied temporary routing rules. Monitoring for stability.
ETA for next update: 30 minutes.
```

rishi (sre): Fine to put that up. Add contact instructions for Opal: "If your application is experiencing failures, please contact Opal support account team or reply to the notification."

lydia (cs): Preparing tailored customer notification to Opal (short message):

```
Hi Opal team — we're investigating degraded inference performance on your dedicated cluster. We've applied mitigations (temporary traffic reroute and rollback of a runtime change) and are monitoring. We expect to send a follow-up update within 30 minutes. If you see persistent failures or need an immediate rollback to hosted, please ping me (lydia) or your account lead (sean).
```

sean (acct): Good. Also include the temporary workaround: switch customer to hosted pool fallback (if Opal approves). Add: "No data exposure; this is a service availability issue."

elaine (eng): Ran sanity checks after rollback; KV cache hit rate improved from 42% -> 89% on the rolled node. If we roll back remainder, risk of partial capacity drop while nodes restart. Recommend staged rollback + controlled routing.

maya (oncall): Escalation plan: if 5xx > 10% for >20 minutes across pools, page infra-lead and exec-oncall. Currently 5xx aggregated ~7% after reroute.

incident-bot: paging: infra-lead (rishi) notified; exec-oncall not paged.

rishi (sre): I'm authorizing staged rollback of runtime on remaining nodes in opal-ded-3 in 5 minutes. Elaine, coordinate restarts during low traffic windows.

elaine (eng): Acknowledged. I'll do node-by-node rollback with healthchecks and `curl` smoke tests: `for n in nodes; do drain $n && rollback $n && smoke $n; done`

lydia (cs): Sending Opal notification now (via Intercom and email). Copying below the exact message to be sent for records:

```
Subject: Incident: Degraded inference service (Opal dedicated pool)
Hi <Opal Contact>,
We are actively investigating degraded inference responses from your dedicated cluster. Our engineering team has applied temporary traffic reroutes and begun rolling back a recent runtime update suspected to be the root cause. We are monitoring closely and will update you within 30 minutes. No customer data has been exposed. If you need immediate relief, we can switch traffic to a hosted fallback upon your approval.
— Lydia, Customer Success
```

ops-bot: notification sent via email (msg id: em-89321) and Intercom (conv id: ic-4456).

maya (oncall): Monitoring. If rollback stabilizes things in next 10–15 minutes we can close incident and post RCA. Otherwise, we'll open a full page for execs.

rishi (sre): After 18 minutes post-rollback, aggregated 5xx fell to 3.1% and p50 latency normalized. Continuing monitoring for 45 more minutes. Good work team.

sean (acct): Opal reply via email: "Appreciate the quick action — keep us posted. We'll hold off on fallback for now." Passing to lydia to keep them calm.

lydia (cs): Noted. I'll keep Opal updated and prep a brief customer-facing RCA template once incident is fully resolved.

incident-bot: incident OPAL-DED-OUTAGE-2026 -> status updated: "mitigated, monitoring".

maya (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing to rishi for post-mitigation monitoring and RCA. rishi, please summarize next steps in this thread and assign owners for RCA + customer comms.

rishi (sre): I'll own RCA (timeline + root cause) with elaine and maya. Lydia will own customer RCA draft; sean will own executive liaison. Target: publish internal RCA and customer summary within 72 hours.

ops-bot: incident closed for active paging at 11:02 UTC.

maya (oncall): Closing notes: key mitigation was rollback of runtime patch r2026.14 and temporary routing changes. Recommend blocking automatic rollout of r2026.14 until root cause confirmed and adding additional canary gating for long-context workloads.

elaine (eng): Agree. I'll add a regression test for long-context KV caching and a perf check in the rollout pipeline.

lydia (cs): I'll send a follow-up to Opal in 30 minutes confirming stabilization and next steps.

sean (acct): Thanks team. Good response. :thumbsup:
